title: docs: fold the ui/ top-level docs into the root README, ROADMAP and CONTRIBUTING (#26080 slice 1)
body:
Part of #26080
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：`ui/` 下的 README、ROADMAP、CONTRIBUTING、QUICK_REFERENCE 四份顶层文档并入根目录同名文档后删除；`ui/CHANGELOG.md` 保留为冻结历史并加一行说明；README 里的代码示例搬到 `ui/content/docs/guide/quick-start.md`。
- 为什么改：裁决 6417494426（A，「其他同意」）第 1 片：一个仓一套贡献说明和路线图，不再有两份入门步骤、两份 ROADMAP。
- 风险与回滚：纯文档和测试改动，外加 33 个 `@object-ui/*` 包 README 里的两条链接（指向已归档的 objectui 仓 → 指向本仓根目录），带 patch changeset；回滚就是 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：① `ui/scripts/check-doc-component-types.mjs` 等三个门禁把 `ROOT_PAGES` 清空（README 示例改由 content/docs 那条腿判）；② `ui/scripts/__tests__/quick-reference-commands-4149.test.ts` 改读根 CONTRIBUTING 的 UI 小节；③ `CONTRIBUTING.md` 新增的 “UI Workspace (`ui/`)” 小节。
- 两分钟验证：在 `ui/` 下跑 `pnpm docs:check-links`，预期输出 `Links are valid across 13 scan roots.`。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

Slice 1 of ruling A on #26080 (comment 6417494426), verbatim: 「其他同意」. The four `ui/` top-level documents are folded into the repository root and deleted.

- **Root `README.md`** gains an "ObjectUI (`ui/`)" subsection under *Hack on the framework*: a workspace description (not a product pitch: no badge row, no three-product block, no links to the archived repository), the hero screenshot, and the two start paths.
- **Root `CONTRIBUTING.md`** gains a "UI Workspace (`ui/`)" section: the UI-only delta of the old `ui/CONTRIBUTING.md` and the whole of `ui/QUICK_REFERENCE.md` (turbo commands, the vitest-from-`ui/` rule and the guard text, examples, layout, docs conventions). A second Package Directory block lists every `@object-ui/*` package, and the License section says contributions under `ui/` are MIT. The root's own setup steps are kept and not duplicated; the stale parts of the old file (fork-from-objectui, the `.objectstack-sha` pin, the `pnpm-merge` driver, objectui's own CI and coverage thresholds) are not carried over.
- **Root `ROADMAP.md`**: the Console bullet and the documentation rule no longer send readers to the sibling `../objectui` repository, and a short "ObjectUI (`ui/`)" section carries the old pointer file's content.
- **`ui/content/docs/guide/quick-start.md`** takes the README's code examples: an "Expression Scope" section ("Basic Usage") and "Copy-Paste Schemas" (Contact Form, Data Grid, Dashboard, Kanban Board). The README's ObjectStack-adapter and custom-`DataSource` snippets are not moved: the quick-start's "Connect a Data Source" and `guide/data-source.md` already carry them.
- **`ui/CHANGELOG.md`** stays, with a one-line frozen-history header.
- **Gates and pins retargeted, none deleted.** `ROOT_PAGES` is emptied in `check-doc-component-types`, `check-doc-snippet-types` and `check-doc-fence-languages` (the guard over it stays); `check-doc-json-fences` drops its root-README leg and that leg's anchor; `check-doc-links` drops the four `SCAN_ROOTS` rows. The pins that asserted the README fences (`page-body-single-node-8310`, `page-body-arity-8310`, `readme-kanban-example-8256`, the 7115 pins in three gate suites) assert the same fences on the quick-start page; `quick-reference-commands-4149` holds the root CONTRIBUTING's UI section to the same anchors (ui scripts, ui workspace packages, paths spelled `ui/...` and resolved in the tree); `object-calendar-container-by-reference-6152` stops adding the deleted README to its corpus. Fixtures that stood a root README / CONTRIBUTING / ROADMAP / QUICK_REFERENCE on the disk rule now use `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md` and `CHANGELOG.md`, the root-level rows that remain. The `markdown-test-inputs` ledger is re-adjudicated against the scanner.
- **Links repointed.** 71 links in 36 files to `objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md` / `ROADMAP.md` (the archived repository; the link gate resolved them against the deleted `ui/` files) now point at this repository's root documents, and so do the relative links in `ui/apps/console/README.md`, `ui/packages/plugin-gantt/ROADMAP.md`, `ui/packages/vscode-extension/{README,DESIGN}.md`, `ui/.changeset/README.md` and `ui/CHANGELOG.md` (a relative path out of `ui/` is refused by the link gate). Three anti-vacuity floors over judged-link counts move down by the measured amount, each with its reason in the comment.
- **One example fixed in place.** Moving "Basic Usage" into `content/docs` put it under the objectui#11436 walk, which reds a taught `page` node that writes `title` with no `pageType` (a record page draws no heading). The README had taught that shape unseen; the example now says `pageType: "app"`. The 8310 pins assert substrings that are unchanged.
- **Changeset** `ui/.changeset/26080-readme-contributing-links.md`: `patch` for the 33 published packages whose shipped `README.md` changed. No code, export or behaviour changes.

Not touched: `ui/lychee.toml` and `ui/turbo.objectui.json` keep live readers (re-confirmed on this head: `ui/scripts/workspace-root.mjs` reads `turbo.objectui.json`, with `ui/scripts/__tests__/helpers/turbo-inputs.ts` and `workspace-root.test.ts`; `ui/scripts/__tests__/check-links-workflow.test.ts` reads `ui/lychee.toml`), so the ruling's delete condition does not hold and they stay on the card. `ui/.claude/**`, the `ui/docs/adr` index prefix, `ui/AGENTS.md` and every governed path are untouched (`check-governed-merges --test`: 0 of 71 paths governed).

Overlap: draft PR #26365 edits `ui/README.md` (drops the `@object-ui/plugin-ai` row) and `ui/QUICK_REFERENCE.md` (the `packages/*` count). This PR deletes both files, which subsumes those two hunks; the `plugin-ai` row now lives in the root CONTRIBUTING's ObjectUI package directory, so whichever of the two lands second removes it there. #26073's edits (root README Community line, `ROADMAP.md:4`, `CONTRIBUTING.md:114`) are in regions this PR does not touch.

## Acceptance notes

- `ui/.gitattributes` still routes `pnpm-lock.yaml` through a `pnpm-merge` driver, and its comment cites the deleted CONTRIBUTING section that defined the driver; `ui/` has no `pnpm-lock.yaml`, so the line matches nothing. Dead config of the same family as `ui/lychee.toml`; left for the card's remaining item. `ui/content/docs/guide/ci-cd-pipeline.md` (its "Lockfile Merge Driver" passage) still describes that CONTRIBUTING instruction.
- `ui/scripts/setup.sh` advertises `pnpm build`, `pnpm lint` and `pnpm create-plugin`, which `ui/package.json` does not declare. Only its two "read this file" lines are repointed here.
- `ui/.changeset/README.md` cites `.github/workflows/changeset-release.yml`, which is gone from `ui/`.
- Package READMEs still link issues and examples in the archived objectui repository; only the CONTRIBUTING / ROADMAP links, which the link gate resolves into this tree, are repointed.
- The README's comparison table against other renderers and its "Why Object UI" form snippet are not carried over (a product pitch, per the card's brand note 6416758216); the four Shadcn / backend / control / typed bullets are folded into the root README paragraph.

## Verification

<details><summary>Local gates: dispatch-gates derivation, 27 families, each exit code captured before any pipe</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --ran`: `27 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 27 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 27 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3)`. Every family exited 0: check-adr-links (+ self-test), check-closing-keyword-parity (+ self-test), check-comment-mask-corpus, check-sdui-manifest (+ self-test), spec check:duration-unit-keys, check:cross-package-test-inputs, check:dispatcher-error-vocabulary, check:doc-anchors, check:driver-memory-census, check:engine-double-contract, check:gitlink-declared, check:nul-bytes, check:published-files, check:query-options-erasure, check:refd-timer-probe, check:skill-identifier-liveness, check:test-source-alias, check:tier-file-adoption, check:type-check-coverage, check:type-check-debt, check:undeclared-dep-imports, check:watch-hint-literal, check:where-matcher, and the ui scripts vitest run above. The check:* families ran on 657dff26f1; the last commit touches only the quick-start page and one test file, and nul-bytes, doc-anchors and cross-package-test-inputs were re-run on 70e7d98027 (exit 0).

Also on 70e7d98027, each exit 0: ui `check:doc-types`, `check:doc-fences`, `docs:check-links` (`Links are valid across 13 scan roots.`), `markdown-test-inputs.mjs --audit` (`107 candidate test files, all adjudicated; 71 declared entries, all present.`), `check-doc-expression-carriage.mjs`, and the ui changeset gates (`check-changeset-fixed`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-changeset-claims`, `check-pending-changeset-literals`).

NOT MEASURED locally: ui `check:doc-json` and `check:doc-snippets` (they need the ui package builds); CI's `Lint UI` / `Test UI` run them. The full farm is CI's.
</details>
